name: Marysville, Kansas
note_en: Twain passes through Marysville on the overland stage journey. The marker represents the town as a whole.
note: 吐温乘长途驿车经过马里斯维尔；标记代表整个城镇。

name: Salt Lake City
note_en: Twain describes the city seen against its surrounding mountains. The marker represents the city as a whole.
note: 吐温描写群山映衬下的盐湖城；标记代表整座城市。

name: Virginia City, Nevada
note_en: Twain turns a single hay wagon into a newspaper story in this Nevada mining town. The marker represents the town, not a verified newspaper-office address.
note: 吐温在这座内华达矿业城镇把一辆运草车编成多条新闻；标记代表城镇，并非已核实的报社地址。

name: Honolulu
note_en: Twain recalls the fruit available during his visit. The marker represents the city as a whole at its present-day civic center, Honolulu Hale; it does not locate the fruit passage at that building.
note: 吐温回忆在此游览时吃到的水果；以今日市政厅的位置代表整个檀香山，供地图定位；并非指水果片段发生在这座建筑里。

name: Mount Hood
note_en: Muir names Mount Hood in his comparison of Cascade volcanoes. The summit marks the mountain as a whole, not his vantage point.
note: 缪尔比较喀斯喀特火山群时提到胡德山；以山顶代表整座山，并非作者观景的位置。

name: Seattle
note_en: Muir describes Seattle and Tacoma as rival growing towns. The marker represents Seattle as a whole.
note: 缪尔描写西雅图与塔科马这两座互相竞争的新兴城镇；标记代表整个西雅图。

name: Tacoma, Washington
note_en: Muir describes Tacoma as Seattle’s rival and a railway terminus. The marker represents the town as a whole.
note: 缪尔将塔科马描写为西雅图的竞争对手及铁路终点；标记代表整个城镇。

name: Wrangell, Alaska
note_en: Muir arrives here by canoe before planning a journey farther north. The marker represents the settlement, not an identified landing.
note: 缪尔乘独木舟抵达此地，继而筹划继续北行；标记代表聚落，并非已确定的登岸地点。

name: Medicine Bow, Wyoming
note_en: The narrator’s train stops here at the beginning of The Virginian. The marker represents the town rather than an identified historic water tank.
note: 《弗吉尼亚人》开篇，叙述者乘坐的列车在这里停靠；标记代表城镇，并非已确定的历史水塔。

name: Lincoln, Nebraska
note_en: Jim stays in Lincoln during his first university summer vacation. The marker represents the city, not a lodging address.
note: 吉姆在大学的第一个暑假留在林肯；标记代表城市，并非他的住址。

name: Omaha, Nebraska
note_en: Marie’s father settles in Omaha and becomes an adviser in its Bohemian community. The marker represents the city as a whole.
note: 玛丽的父亲定居奥马哈，成为当地波希米亚移民的顾问；标记代表整座城市。

name: Ordway, South Dakota
note_en: In the author’s preface, Garland recalls travelling to Ordway, where his parents lived. This is a nonfiction preface location, represented by the settlement point.
note: 加兰在作者序言中回忆前往父母居住的奥德韦；这是非虚构序言中的地点，以聚落坐标代表。

name: Gallup, New Mexico
note_en: Gallup is a named waypoint in the novel’s Route 66 panorama. The marker represents the town, not a particular migrant stop.
note: 盖洛普是小说描写六十六号公路时点名的沿途城镇；标记代表城镇，并非特定移民停靠点。

name: Flagstaff, Arizona
note_en: Flagstaff is a named waypoint in the novel’s Route 66 panorama. The marker represents the city as a whole.
note: 弗拉格斯塔夫是小说描写六十六号公路时点名的沿途城镇；标记代表整座城市。

name: Sallisaw, Oklahoma
note_en: Tom Joad returns to his family’s home near Sallisaw. The town point represents the surrounding setting; it does not locate the fictional farm.
note: 汤姆·乔德回到萨利索附近的家；以城镇坐标代表周边故事区域，并非虚构农场的精确位置。

name: Weedpatch Camp
note_en: The real migrant camp informed the government camp depicted in The Grapes of Wrath. The marker identifies the historic camp.
note: 这座真实的移民劳工营地为《愤怒的葡萄》中的政府营地提供了素材；标记指向历史营地。
prototype_of: 《愤怒的葡萄》中的政府移民营地
prototype_of_en: The government migrant camp in The Grapes of Wrath

name: Denver
note_en: Sal meets Dean, Carlo and their circle in Denver on his first westward trip. The marker represents the city as a whole.
note: 萨尔初次西行时在丹佛与迪安、卡洛及他们的朋友会合；标记代表整座城市。

name: San Francisco
note_en: Sal’s first westward journey takes him to Remi and a night-watchman job in San Francisco. The marker represents the city, not the camp’s precise site.
note: 萨尔初次西行来到旧金山，投奔雷米并当上守夜人；标记代表城市，并非营地的精确位置。

name: Fargo, North Dakota
note_en: Steinbeck compares the Fargo he visits with the place he has imagined. The marker represents the city as a whole.
note: 斯坦贝克将亲见的法戈与心中的想象比较；标记代表整座城市。

name: Billings, Montana
note_en: Steinbeck buys a hat in Billings as he lingers in Montana. The marker represents the city, not an identified shop.
note: 斯坦贝克流连蒙大拿时在比灵斯买了一顶帽子；标记代表城市，并非已确定的店铺。

name: Kuna, Idaho
note_en: Kuna is one of the Idaho settings in the Wards’ western story. The marker represents the settlement as a whole.
note: 库纳是沃德一家西部经历中的爱达荷地点之一；标记代表整个聚落。

name: Leadville, Colorado
note_en: Leadville belongs to the Wards’ mining-world itinerary in Angle of Repose. The marker represents the town as a whole.
note: 莱德维尔是《安息角》中沃德一家在矿业世界辗转的地点之一；标记代表整个城镇。
